subject: Verdant Labs private deployment - network constraints & staffing handoff
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.example>
To: Alice Chen <alice.chen@verdantlabs.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.example>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.example>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.example>
Date: Thu, 10 Sep 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Verdant Labs private deployment - initial handoff & network constraints

Hi Alice —

Thanks again for choosing Redwood for the private deployment. This thread will be our primary handoff for networking, on‑prem packaging, and the implementation staffing plan. Quick summary of what we need to confirm before the kickoff call: 

- Network inventory: subnets, NAT/egress model, and whether you have a dedicated transit/edge account. I attached a simple inventory template (verdant_network_inventory.xlsx) — can you populate and return?
- VPC peering vs private endpoints: if peering is preferred we need your peering CIDR and expected traffic patterns; if endpoints, we'll share private endpoint IPs and DNS expectations.
- Appliance/on‑prem package options: would you like the appliance deployed first or start with private endpoints + appliance later? We can stage the rollout.
- KMS/HSM requirements: if you require external HSM or a particular KMS key policy, flag it now so security can review.
- Maintenance window: please propose 2 possible 4‑hour windows in the next 2 weeks for peering cuts.

Proposed next steps:
1) You return the inventory sheet.
2) We hold a 30‑min preflight with network/sysops + security (we can do Sept 17 or 18) to validate the egress list and peering plan.
3) We publish the implementation playbook (draft attached) and assign owners.

Attachments: verdant_network_inventory.xlsx, redwood_onprem_manifest_v1.pdf

Thanks — looping in Camila (implementation lead), Irene (security engineering), and Laura (CS lead) to own their parts.

—Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Customer Success, Redwood Inference
From: Alice Chen <alice.chen@verdantlabs.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.example>
Cc: Ops Team <ops@verdantlabs.com>
Date: Fri, 11 Sep 2026 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Verdant Labs private deployment - initial handoff & network constraints

Karthik — thanks, this is helpful. A few constraints from our side: 

- We cannot accept inbound peering until our compliance officer signs the third‑party risk assessment (expected by Sep 20). We can, however, provision private endpoints ahead of time and validate DNS/route tables.
- Preferred maintenance window: Sep 22 00:00–04:00 UTC (our change freeze ends on Sep 23). Alternate: Sep 24 02:00–06:00 UTC.
- KMS: we use AWS KMS, but we do have an HSM-backed key for production. Security will want to validate the key policy; CC'ing Maria (security lead).

I've attached the partially filled network inventory (see reference to our transit account and egress ranges). Ops contact for cutover coordination is ops@verdantlabs.com.

On the appliance path — we'd prefer to test private endpoints in staging first, then schedule the appliance install for a separate maintenance window.

--
Alice Chen
VP, Platform Engineering
Verdant Labs
From: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.example>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.example>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.example>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.example>
Date: Sat, 12 Sep 2026 11:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Verdant Labs private deployment - initial handoff & network constraints

Thanks for the update and Alice for the details. Quick internal proposal (two‑phase rollout):

Phase 1 — Staging private endpoints + DNS validation (no inbound peering)
- Tasks: share private endpoint IPs, configure DNS delegation, validate egress NAT.
- Owners: Camila (implementation), Laura (CS coordination).

Phase 2 — Peering & appliance cutover (post compliance sign‑off)
- Tasks: prepare peering CIDRs, BGP plan (if used), appliance install checklist, switch traffic over.
- Owners: Infra ops on Verdant side + Prio: PrIyom (appliance packaging and remote install doc).

Checklist items I want in the playbook: 
- Preflight: inventory, IP allowlist, IAM roles for our runner, cert provisioning steps.
- Fallback: DNS rollback plan, healthcheck thresholds, canary traffic targets.

Karthik — can you ask Laura to lead stool calls with Verdant's ops on Monday (Sep 14) so we can gather the missing inventory fields and confirm the preflight scope? I'll draft the phased timeline and hand it back.

Camila
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

Laura — could you own the customer preflight coordination? Specific asks: 
1) Schedule a 30‑min preflight with Verdant ops on Sep 17 (they're available Sep 17 or 18 per my calendar).
2) Confirm we have the KMS/HSM questionnaire items for Maria (Irene, can you prepare a short list of what you need to sign off?)
3) Share the draft implementation_playbook_draft.md link in the preflight so Verdant can comment.

Priyom — please prep the on‑prem packaging checklist and remote install runbook (appliance image, expected disk layout, user accounts, and secure transport steps) and attach to the playbook before the preflight.

I'll take care of confirming the maintenance window with Alice (I will propose Sep 22 00:00–04:00 UTC as primary).

—Karthik

Karthik / Laura —

Confirmed: Sep 22 00:00–04:00 UTC works for the endpoint validation window. Maria (cc'd) will review the KMS policy and confirm by Sep 20. Ops (ops@verdantlabs.com) will join the preflight on Sep 17.

Request for preflight: can you share a short preflight checklist that our ops/security team can review ahead of the call? Items we want on it: required IAM permissions, expected egress IPs, cert thumbprint checks, and any host‑level hardening steps for the appliance image.

Forwarding the partially filled inventory and adding Maria's note about the HSM key rotation schedule.

Thanks — looking forward to the preflight.

Best,
Alice
VP, Platform Engineering
Verdant Labs
